title: The Last Canteen
intro: A dehydrated courier is hiding beneath a torn awning. Her sealed satchel is marked for a clinic.
outcome: She marks the next courier stop on her route and promises to remember you.

title: No More Bandages
intro: A roadside medic has a patient on a folding cot and nothing left to stop the bleeding.
outcome: The patient stabilizes. The medic packs a field kit for you.

title: Cold Supper
intro: Two exhausted walkers split an empty tin beside a dead cooking fire.
outcome: They share a route through the next district and a little of their ammunition.

title: The Bitter Well
intro: A water carrier says the emergency filter has clogged. The last clean bottles are reserved for children.
outcome: The carrier gets the clean-water run moving again.

title: A Debt on the Road
intro: The courier you helped recognizes you. She has returned from the clinic with supplies to spare.
outcome: She presses the supplies into your hands. Some debts travel farther than people.

title: Waiting Out the Rain
intro: Stranded walkers are shivering beside soaked bedrolls. They need food before continuing.
outcome: The walkers leave a dry ammunition pouch as thanks.

title: Broken Axle
intro: A scavenger has jacked up a van on timber blocks. A broken bracket is all that keeps him here.
outcome: The repair holds. He pays you from his delivery money.

title: Dead Air
intro: An isolated relay repeats a distress fragment. A technician points to a burned contactor.
outcome: The relay wakes up. Somewhere down the road, a second station answers.

title: The Warm Medicine
intro: A delivery driver is losing a refrigerator full of medicine. The cooling unit has seized.
outcome: Cold air returns to the cases. The driver hands over a preserved medical pack.

title: Water Under Pressure
intro: A hand-painted sign promises clean water, but the roadside pump has fallen silent.
outcome: The pump starts. The operator fills bottles for the next travelers.

title: Ground Fault
intro: Rainwater has drowned a camp generator. Its owner has disconnected it, but needs help rebuilding the starter.
outcome: The lamps come back on under the awning.

title: Last Box of Shells
intro: A cautious broker offers a sealed box of shotgun shells. He will only trade in the open.
outcome: The broker counts your credits twice, then slides over the box.

title: Night Pharmacy
intro: A lantern-lit medical seller has opened for the graveyard shift. No names, no questions.
outcome: The seller wraps your medicine in clean paper.

title: The Traveling Locksmith
intro: A locksmith trades carefully made picks from a roll of tools spread across his bonnet.
outcome: He demonstrates the tension wrench before handing you the roll.

title: Ration Exchange
intro: A cook is offering preserved meals in exchange for clean water.
outcome: The cook gives you freshly packed traveling rations.

title: Weight in Metal
intro: A repair caravan has run out of usable metal. Its quartermaster is paying for scrap.
outcome: Your scrap disappears into organized bins; the quartermaster pays the agreed rate.

title: Keep the Signal Alive
intro: The repaired relay is transmitting a convoy route. Its operator needs you to hold the perimeter until the burst finishes.
outcome: The convoy receives the route. The operator records your call sign.

title: Firelight Siege
intro: A camp cook is banging a pan as infected shapes approach the fire. Someone must keep them outside the camp.
outcome: The fire stays lit. The camp shares what it can spare.

title: The Last Stretcher
intro: The medic you supplied is moving patients. The evacuation cannot leave until the road is clear.
outcome: The last patient gets away. A crate of reserve medicine remains for you.

title: Rear Guard
intro: A supply convoy is retreating behind a barricade. Raiders are searching for a weak point.
outcome: The convoy escapes the district and leaves its emergency pay chest.

title: The Caged Scout
intro: A scout is trapped behind a makeshift barricade. The guards are close enough to hear a raised voice.
outcome: With the guards gone, the scout cuts through the restraints and shares recovered ammunition.

title: Cornered Runner
intro: A runner is balancing on a wreck while rabid dogs circle below.
outcome: The runner climbs down and offers a spare medical kit.

title: Under the Machinery
intro: A technician is pinned behind collapsed equipment. Infected workers are drawn to his calls.
outcome: The technician limps free and hands you the maintenance locker contents.

title: No Vacancy
intro: A motel guest escaped through a window but cannot get past the infected on the access road.
outcome: The guest recovers a hidden travel bag and shares its supplies.

title: Undelivered
intro: A battered postal case sits beside an overturned handcart. Its delivery log ends months ago.
outcome: Inside are supplies addressed to a district that no longer answers.

title: Blue Tape
intro: Blue tape marks a locked evidence case beneath an abandoned roadside checkpoint.
outcome: The case contains ammunition and an old emergency authorization.

title: What the Rain Revealed
intro: Runoff has stripped the soil from a sealed supply drum. Its latch is packed with rust.
outcome: The seal kept the contents dry through years underground.

title: The Scout's Promise
intro: The scout you rescued left a trail mark and a cache exactly where promised.
outcome: A note reads: I do not forget who came back for me.

title: A Voice Too Calm
intro: A distress loop plays from a receiver. No one answers your calls, but fresh bootprints surround the station.
outcome: The transmission goes silent. You recover the bait supplies.

title: Open Invitation
intro: A wreck has its cargo lid propped open. The neatly arranged supplies look untouched.
outcome: The ambushers will not be using this wreck again.

title: The Whistle
intro: A whistle sounds twice beyond a deserted campsite. Something moves in the brush.
outcome: The pack disperses. You find the hunters' abandoned supplies.

title: Silent Procession
intro: Clothes and luggage lie in a careful line along the verge. The figures beyond them have stopped moving.
outcome: The procession ends at a pile of discarded rations.

title: Lost Surveyor
intro: A surveyor has lost her bearings in the fog. She needs someone to walk her to the next road marker.
outcome: She reaches the marker and gives you a copy of her supply coordinates.

title: Walking Wounded
intro: An injured traveler can walk, but only slowly. The next safe pull-off is a short distance down the road.
outcome: The traveler reaches the rendezvous and offers a keepsake pouch.

title: The Last Passenger
intro: A stranded passenger refuses to spend another night beside the dead bus.
outcome: At the rendezvous, the passenger finally throws away the old bus ticket.

title: A Second Chance
intro: The technician you rescued is ready to move his tools. He asks you to walk the exposed stretch with him.
outcome: He reaches his pickup point and pays for the escort.

title: The Alpha Pack
intro: A traveler points out a feeding ground. The largest dogs have been stalking this road for days.
outcome: The road falls quiet. The traveler releases the promised bounty.

title: Long Shadows
intro: Spent brass litters a lookout. Raiders have been firing on anyone crossing the next stretch.
outcome: The lookout is clear. You recover their ammunition reserve.

title: End of Shift
intro: Infected workers keep returning to the same maintenance stop. A scavenger offers a bounty for clearing it.
outcome: The scavenger can finally retrieve the crew's tools.

title: Numbers at Midnight
intro: A receiver repeats groups of numbers under a wash of static. Holding the frequency may reveal the whole message.
outcome: The final numbers identify a relief cache. The operator releases its supplies.

title: A Reply at Last
intro: The convoy you helped is on the air. They need a relay operator to acknowledge their arrival.
outcome: Their safe-arrival code comes through. They authorize a supply payment.

title: Fallen Weather Station
intro: A weather instrument has landed in the ditch. Its recorder still has enough power for one download.
outcome: The recording yields a route advisory and an emergency maintenance kit.

title: Names on Tin
intro: Names are scratched into scraps of tin. A caretaker asks you to stay for a moment while he reads them.
outcome: The caretaker thanks you for listening and shares a wrapped meal.

title: One More Birthday
intro: A lone traveler has put a candle on an unopened ration. Today would have been his daughter's birthday.
outcome: You sit through the silence together. He gives you a small medical pouch.

title: A Pair of Boots
intro: A pair of boots sits beside a freshly filled grave. A friend is waiting for the courage to leave.
outcome: After a few quiet minutes, the traveler picks up the empty pack and heads on.

title: Yellow Water
intro: A ruptured chemical drum is leaking across the verge. A warning lamp marks the contaminated ground.
outcome: You isolate the leaking drum and recover the sealed clean supplies.

title: Live Wire
intro: A fallen cable spits light into rainwater. The cutoff box is reachable from the dry shoulder.
outcome: The circuit goes dead. The recovery case is safe to open.

title: Pressure Leak
intro: A buried steam line has split beneath a maintenance hatch. The pressure valve is jammed.
outcome: The steam thins. An old service kit remains inside the hatch.

title: Heat in the Drums
intro: A stack of supply drums has begun to smoke. Clean water could cool the hottest one before it ruptures.
outcome: The drums cool enough to recover the undamaged cargo.

title: The Engine Picker
intro: A mechanic has exposed an engine block. The remaining parts will take patience to separate.
outcome: The useful components come free without breaking.

title: Under the Canvas
intro: An old roadside shelter has folded over its supply chest. The frame must be lifted clear.
outcome: The frame gives way, revealing a dry chest.

title: Flat-Pack Apocalypse
intro: A furniture delivery has scattered sealed tool packs along the verge. A collector is sorting what survived.
outcome: You assemble a useful set from the broken cartons.

title: Private Road
intro: Armed collectors demand a road fee. Their barricade does not actually block the whole road.
outcome: The collectors pocket the payment and agree to leave you alone.

title: Quarantine Fee
intro: Men wearing borrowed medical bands demand payment for a nonexistent inspection.
outcome: They wave you through without getting any closer.

title: Counting the Living
intro: A volunteer is counting travelers for the settlements. He asks you to watch the road while he repairs his tally board.
outcome: The count continues. He shares the supplies assigned to this shift.

title: The Falling Lights
intro: A stargazer has set up an improvised observation station. She asks you to keep watch during a brief recording.
outcome: The recording finishes. For once, the lights overhead belong to something distant.
